issues.on_page: Other 14,580,703 (fund columns: General 3,598,123, Jail Bond 7,938, Inheritance 3,181,152, Road 306,352, Insurance 4,937,847, B&I 15,176, Other Govt 2,534,115)
issues.issue: The State line was split into its fund-schedule pieces, but the Other line was not, although the schedules (pp6, 8-12) print its full breakdown. That breakdown includes inheritance tax 2,881,152, fees of office and commissions about 2.7M, lottery 907,405, 911 surcharges 169,913, in lieu of tax 80,016, commissary 475,178 and others. No single category is more than half, so keeping it as 'other' is defensible, but the treatment is inconsistent with the State line.

General Government - Misc. Operating Expense 1,495,626 is the department's only line, and its budget is printed (p7, p13). Other single-line departments (Public Health, Stuhr Museum, Equipment Acquisition, Grants) were given their budget.
Supt. of Schools Operating Expense 4,000 is a single-line department with a printed budget of 4,000.
Public Safety - Misc. Operating Expense 702,873 is a single-line department with a printed budget of 756,747.
Public Works - Misc. Operating Expense 139,254 is a single-line department with a printed budget of 143,942.
This is an assessment charged to landowners, so special assessments could also fit. Judgment call.
